body:
【这是 AirPods 搭载摄像头并运用视觉智能技术的首次实机演示】
这段泄露的 macOS 26.7 RC 测试版视频展示了内置摄像头的 AirPods 如何利用视觉智能技术捕捉周围环境，例如，佩戴耳机时举起书本即可识别书名。
苹果的 B790 AirPods 可以通过摄像头实时分析并保存信息，从而支持 Siri 查询环境信息。如果头发遮挡摄像头，影响拍摄效果，AirPods 还会发出警报。
这项功能似乎已接近发布，最早可能在 9 月份与 iPhone 18 系列一同亮相，标志着视觉智能技术的应用范围将显著扩展至现有设备之外。
#苹果大波新品泄密#
Here is your first look at AirPods with Cameras in action using Visual Intelligence.
This is leaked video from macOS 26.7 RC demonstrating AirPods with built-in cameras using Visual Intelligence to capture surroundings, such as identifying a book title when held up while wearing the earbuds.
Apple's B790 AirPods enable Siri-powered queries about the environment by feeding camera data for real-time analysis and saving details, with an alert triggered if hair obstructs the camera for accurate capture.
The feature appears nearly launch-ready and could debut as early as September alongside iPhone 18 models, marking a significant expansion of Visual Intelligence beyond current devices.
